steps: Fresh anonymous context, http://127.0.0.1:5173/studio-lab, wait for status 'Demo collection ready', focus first library option, Enter (1 clip on Music).
Click inside the clip 300 px from its left edge (marker 7.500), blur.
mouse.down at clip x+120 and move 6 px (hold; a pointer gesture is active: plain Control+ArrowRight now shows 'Editing does not work while dragging — let go first.').

document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'ArrowRight',code:'ArrowRight',ctrlKey:true,modifierAltGraph:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true})) — altKey false, AltGraph true (the AG6 contract state).
Read [data-testid=arrangement-insert-marker] data-insert-marker and the status before mouse.up.
bugs.expected: As at HEAD 7ba7cd2 (control server :5174, same script): blocked during the gesture — marker stays 7.500, event prevented, status 'Editing does not work while dragging — let go first.'.
bugs.actual: Diff: the chord passes the gesture arm (commandChord false, !modifier false), skips the letter branches and reaches the Ctrl+Arrow branch ((event.ctrlKey && !event.altKey)): preventDefault + stepMarker mid-gesture — marker 7.500 -> 101.352 (clip end), no blocked message. Same at 1440x900 and 1280x720. Regression introduced by the changed hunk at StudioWorkspace.tsx l.2324 (gesture arm modifier -> commandChord). Reachability: Playwright real input on this Linux Chromium (keyboard.down('AltGraph')) yields altGraph=false and ctrl only with Control, so the state was not produced by real input here; it is the task's own contract state (AG6), not shown on a real platform. Ctrl+Alt / Meta+Alt / Ctrl+Alt+AltGraph + Arrow during a gesture changed from 'blocked + message + prevented' (HEAD) to silent pass-through, not prevented, marker unchanged (Info; consistent with the letter rule but not stated in the task's 'do not change' list). This is A's STOP A-R267-REVIEW-GESTURE-ARROW, which B has not ruled on (L10).
